The terminal app is rewritten from scratch in TypeScript on OpenTUI. It replaces the Python/Textual app from v5.x and ships as a single-file binary for macOS, Linux and Windows.

## Highlights

- **Overview dashboard.** The app opens on the semester at a glance: overall attendance, what's due this week, your grades, attendance per course against the requirement, and upcoming deadlines. Pick a deadline and press `enter` to jump to it.
- **One screen.** The course list sits beside the selected course, with tabs for files, assignments, grades and announcements.
- **Attendance maths.** Each course shows its percentage against a 75% requirement, plus how many classes you can still miss, or how many in a row you need to attend to get back.
- **Needs you.** Unsubmitted assignments that are due soon and courses below the attendance requirement, in one quiet row under the header.
- **Bulk downloads.** Mark courses with `space`, press `d`. Files go to `~/Downloads/MyDy/<course>/`, and files you already have are skipped.
- **Works offline.** The last synced data is cached, so you can still read it when MyDy is unreachable.
- **Saved login.** Sign in once with Remember me on (the default) and the login is kept in the system keychain. The app signs back in by itself when the session expires.
- **Mouse support.** Click to select, click again to open, scroll to move.
- **Icons.** Nerd Font icons when your terminal can show them (detected automatically), plain symbols otherwise. `mydy --install-font` installs JetBrainsMono Nerd Font for you.
- **The website's dither.** The orange waves drift behind the header and the sign-in screen. `--no-animations` keeps them still.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://deeptanshuu.github.io/mydy-lms-helper/install.sh | sh
```

Windows (PowerShell):

```powershell
irm https://deeptanshuu.github.io/mydy-lms-helper/install.ps1 | iex
```

Then run `mydy`. The installer picks the right build, checks it against `SHA256SUMS` and puts it on your PATH.

Or download the file for your system from the assets below:

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `mydy-darwin-arm64` |
| macOS, Intel | `mydy-darwin-x64` |
| Linux, x64 | `mydy-linux-x64` |
| Linux, ARM64 | `mydy-linux-arm64` |
| Windows, x64 | `mydy-windows-x64.exe` |
| Chrome extension | `mydy-extension.zip` |

The binaries are not signed or notarized. macOS calls a browser download "damaged" until you clear its quarantine flag, which the installer avoids:

```sh
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine mydy-darwin-arm64 && chmod +x mydy-darwin-arm64
./mydy-darwin-arm64
```

On Windows, run `mydy-windows-x64.exe` from a terminal; SmartScreen may ask you to confirm.

The Chrome extension downloads your course files from the browser: extract `mydy-extension.zip`, open `chrome://extensions/`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked** and pick the folder.

Sign in with `MYDY_USERNAME` and `MYDY_PASSWORD` (environment or a `.env` file), a saved login, or the sign-in screen, in that order. Keys, icons and configuration are covered in the [TUI guide](https://github.com/Deeptanshuu/mydy-lms-helper/blob/main/tui/README.md).

## Notes

- **Assets are renamed.** v5.x shipped `lms_helper_*` files. From this release they are `mydy-<os>-<arch>`.
- **The MCP server moved** from `tui/` to `mcp/`. If you registered it with an MCP client, point it at `mcp/mcp_server.py`. Setup is in the [MCP guide](https://github.com/Deeptanshuu/mydy-lms-helper/blob/main/mcp/README.md).
- **Config file** (optional): `~/.config/mydy/config.json`, or `%APPDATA%\mydy\config.json` on Windows. Keys: `downloadDir`, `nerdFont` (`true`, `false` or `"auto"`, the default), `threshold`, `animations`.
- **Linux builds target glibc distributions.** They are not built for musl-based systems such as Alpine.
- **Nerd Font:** installing one isn't enough; select it in your terminal's settings too. Use the regular variant (for example JetBrainsMono Nerd Font), not the Mono variant. `--nerd-font`, `--no-nerd-font` or `MYDY_NERD_FONT=1`/`0` override the detection.
- **The Chrome extension** is now called MyDy Extension and ships with this release as `mydy-extension.zip`. It is also released on its own under `ext-v*` tags.
- Website and live demo: https://deeptanshuu.github.io/mydy-lms-helper/

Unofficial and not affiliated with D.Y. Patil or MyDy. Your login is only sent to MyDy.
